title: Quaternary Covering Code K_4(8,4) Upper-Bound Workbench
description: Reproducible prerelease package for K_4(8,4). A verified 27-word quaternary length-8 code has exact covering radius 4 and improves the audited upper bound from 28 to 27. A retained 26-word candidate has exactly five radius-4 holes.
notes: Prerelease metadata only. The public repository exists, but an immutable paper-inclusive release must precede any Zenodo deposit.
